Cain_1: first son of Adam (Genesis 4:1), cursed from the ground (Genesis 4:11)
Abel_1: son of Adam(Genesis 4:2), first person murdered (Genesis 4:8)
Joseph_1: eleventh-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 30:24)
Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Barak_1: summoned by Deborah (Judges 4:6) to defeat Jabin's army (Judges 4:15)
Gideon_1: son of Joash (Judges 6:11) who torn down the altar to Baal (Judges 6:25)
Samson_1: son of Manoah (Judges 13:24), who killed a thousand men with the jawbone of a donkey (Judges 15:15)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Samuel_2: son of Elkanah and Hannah (1 Samuel 1:20)
